malvon.title: Malvón
malvon.subtitle: Behind the counter
malvon.tagline: Behind every empanada there is a system.
malvon.synopsis: A chain of handmade empanadas with stores in several countries and a sister brand, Brianzzi. Sales, quality, finance, new flavours, hardware and reviews were scattered across spreadsheets and emails. This is the story of how every department got its own tool, all connected from a single portal.

portal.title: Corporate Portal
portal.tagline: It all starts with a door.
portal.text: The company's starting point. From here every department (Technology, Operations, Expansion, Finance, Factory and Development) jumps into its own app and finds the internal forms. One entrance for the whole ecosystem.

operaciones.title: Operations & Sales
operaciones.tagline: Every week, every store, under the microscope.
operaciones.text: The supervisors' dashboard. It tracks opening and closing compliance for every store, compares it with the previous week and flags in red whatever is at risk. It also handles supervisions, training and records across the network.

finanzas.title: Finance
finanzas.tagline: Numbers don't lie. But someone has to crunch them.
finanzas.text: A simulator that works out the cost of producing an order, the capital it needs and the expected revenue for each rate. It follows every batch from purchase to sale and shows revenue, invoices and average ticket month by month.

calidad.title: Quality
calidad.tagline: Not a single empanada out of line.
calidad.text: The factory's quality control. It compares Malvón and Brianzzi on acceptance rate, metal detection and deviations by count and by weight, so every pack leaves the plant the way it should.

id.title: R&D · New flavours
id.tagline: The future is invented in the kitchen.
id.text: The flavour lab. The kitchen team opens research projects, tries versions, saves every recipe change and keeps the flavour and ingredient catalogue for both brands. With dark mode, for long nights of testing.

inventario.title: IT Inventory
inventario.text: The record of all the company's hardware: laptops, servers, monitors, phones, tablets and routers. It shows what is assigned, what is free and what is in quarantine, and keeps the history of incidents and repairs.

itsm.title: ITSM · Work management
itsm.text: Mission control for the day to day: tasks, projects, promotions and prices in one place. Everyone sees their own work, what is due today and what needs their action, with internal chat and an AI assistant.

resenas.title: Reviews
resenas.tagline: What people say about us, store by store.
resenas.text: It connects to Google Business Profile and gathers the reviews of every store. Filter by country, group or store, compare the last two weeks with the all-time average and export reports as CSV or PDF.

canalB2b.title: B2B Channel · Brianzzi
canalB2b.tagline: The sister brand gets its scene too.
canalB2b.text: Brianzzi's portal for its professional channel. It sums up the last twelve months of sales, the trend and results of audits, sample orders and change requests.
